name: Kido Satoru
source:
A gumshoe on the payroll at a Detective Agency. Chain-smokes his way through almost two packs of Hi-Lites daily.
Marches to the beat of his own drum and can't stand society's rules and moral hangups, but he's not quite the full-blown rebel without a cause.
He's no workaholic, but when push comes to shove, he's sharp as a tack.
A man of few words who sees the world as it is. Has a bit of a reputation as a ladies' man—and not in a good way.

[Translated from the official site]
